manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Fiend Hunter must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
